greeting: You have reached Sundial Medicare provider line. This system uses speech recognition.

root.prompt: In a few words, tell me what you're calling about. You can say claims, eligibility, or appeals.
root.retryPrompt: I'm sorry, I didn't understand. You can say claims, eligibility, or appeals.
root.failText: I'm having trouble understanding. Please call back later. Goodbye.

npi.prompt: Please say the ten digit provider N P I, one digit at a time.
npi.invalidText: That N P I does not appear to be valid.

member-id.prompt: Say the member number. It is four digits, two letters, then four digits.
member-id.invalidText: That member number does not match our records format.
member-id.failText: We are unable to verify the member. Goodbye.

route.prompt: Say status to hear automated claim status, or say representative to wait for an agent.

status-readout.template: For member {memberId}, N P I {npi}: one claim on file. Status: denied. Reason code C O dash one six, additional information required. A remittance was mailed. To appeal, submit within sixty days. Thank you.

hold.prompt: Please hold. Current wait time is greater than twenty minutes.

rep.prompt: Sundial provider services, representative speaking. May I have your name and the N P I?
